culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments at fair value (cost/amortized cost of $ 231,731 ) | $ | 231,531

findings.detail: A separately presented $231.531 million portfolio schedule was included in addition to the filing's $1,249.444 million investment total, exactly explaining the overstatement.

rationale: The filing repeatedly reports March 31, 2026 total investments at fair value of $1,249.444 million (including table 12 row 7 and table 20 row 23). The extracted holdings sum is $1,480.975 million, an excess of exactly $231.531 million. Raw source table 30 row 4 and table 33 row 62 independently identify a separate portfolio schedule totaling $231.531 million. The exact residual tie shows that this separate schedule was double counted rather than representing additional consolidated investments.
